idea-plugin.name: MavenUp
idea-plugin.description:
IntelliJ plugin for Maven projects to simplify dependency and plugin management. It provides a clear table view of all declared components and enables easy updates to newer versions.

Features:
  • Dependency & Plugin Overview: Displays all dependencies and plugins declared in Maven projects.
  • Dependency Management Support: Automatically detects whether a dependency is managed directly or via dependencyManagement.
  • Maven Properties (Variables): Shows Maven property names (e.g., ${spring.version}) in a dedicated column.
  • Update Check: Checks for newer versions in configured repositories at the click of a button.
  • Select & Update Versions: Select new versions from a dropdown and automatically update the pom.xml.
  • Navigation: Jump directly to the definition in the pom.xml via double-click (or optional single-click).
  • Multi-Source Vulnerability Check: Checks direct components and resolved transitive dependencies through OSV.dev, with optional Maven-focused enrichment from Sonatype OSS Index.
  • Detailed Security Findings: Shows deduplicated advisory IDs, aliases, severity/CVSS, summaries, sources, and references while filtering withdrawn advisories and safely retaining advisories with newer CVSS versions.
  • Secure and Responsive Credentials: Stores optional OSS Index credentials in IntelliJ Password Safe, loads them outside the UI thread, and links to the Sonatype account page for obtaining a token.
  • Responsive Refresh: Collects Maven project and PSI data through non-blocking background read actions before updating the UI.
  • Compact Diagnostics: Keeps INFO logs concise and limits detailed version and component lists to truncated DEBUG output.
  • Maintainable Architecture: Internally structured into dedicated model, service, and UI layers.
  • Service-based API Integration: External metadata and multi-source vulnerability requests are handled in dedicated service classes.
